slot_scores.name: minimize_total_production_and_storage_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize total cost (production plus storage), or is there another objective such as maximizing profit or meeting demand at any cost?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and whether it is total production plus storage cost, fully covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: demand_must_be_met_each_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Must all demand be met exactly in the week it occurs, or can demand in a given week be satisfied by production from earlier weeks held in storage?
slot_scores.rationale: The question addressed timing of demand satisfaction and storage, but did not explicitly ask whether demand must be fully met or whether backorders/unmet demand are allowed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: All weekly demand must be fully satisfied, with no backorders or unmet demand allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed whether demand must be fully met each week or whether shortfalls/backorders are permitted; the READY_TO_MODEL summary and model treat demand satisfaction as mandatory.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 demand-satisfaction obligation was only partially addressed and remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the core objective and several modeling details, but only partially clarified whether weekly demand must be fully met, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
